sections.heading: WHO IS RESPONSIBLE
sections.body: [INSERT LEGAL ENTITY NAME] OPERATES GOGYMGO AND IS RESPONSIBLE FOR PERSONAL INFORMATION UNDER ITS CONTROL. THE DESIGNATED PRIVACY OFFICER IS [INSERT POSITION TITLE]. QUESTIONS, ACCESS OR CORRECTION REQUESTS, CONSENT WITHDRAWALS, AND COMPLAINTS MAY BE SENT TO [INSERT PRIVACY EMAIL], [INSERT BUSINESS ADDRESS], OR [INSERT BUSINESS TELEPHONE].

sections.heading: SCOPE
sections.body: THIS DRAFT APPLIES TO THE GOGYMGO MOBILE APP, CONNECTED WEB PAGES, ACCOUNT AND COMPETITION SERVICES, PARTNER AND CREATOR APPLICATIONS, SUPPORT, AND RELATED COMMUNICATIONS. THE SEPTEMBER 2026 INTERNAL PILOT IS LIMITED TO ELIGIBLE ADULTS PHYSICALLY LOCATED ON VANCOUVER ISLAND OR AN INCLUDED GULF ISLAND WHEN REGION VERIFICATION OCCURS.

sections.heading: INFORMATION WE COLLECT
bullets: ACCOUNT AND IDENTITY INFORMATION, INCLUDING FIREBASE USER ID, EMAIL, EMAIL-VERIFICATION STATUS, SIGN-IN PROVIDER, PRIVATE CALLSIGN, OPTIONAL PUBLIC ALIAS OR APPROVED NAME MODE, OPTIONAL AVATAR, ACCOUNT STATUS, AND SETTINGS.

REGION INFORMATION, INCLUDING ONE FOREGROUND LATITUDE AND LONGITUDE PAIR WHEN YOU TAP USE MY LOCATION. THE SERVER USES THE PAIR TO TEST AN ACTIVE BOUNDARY, THEN STORES THE APPROVED REGION, POLICY AND BOUNDARY VERSIONS, METHOD, RESULT, AND TIME. THE COORDINATE PAIR IS NOT STORED IN THE REGION-VERIFICATION RECORD.

FITNESS AND WORKOUT INFORMATION, INCLUDING WEEKLY GOAL, ENROLLMENT, SESSION TIMES, DURATION, HEART-RATE SAMPLES OR SUMMARY EVIDENCE, VERIFIED DAYS, STREAKS, SCORING, PRIZE-DRAW ENTRIES, SESSION STATUS, AND FRAUD-REVIEW RESULTS.

DEVICE-PRESENCE AND PARTNER-GYM EVIDENCE, INCLUDING PASS OR FAIL RESULTS, CHECKPOINT TIMES, SESSION IDENTIFIERS, VALIDATED ENTRY OR EXIT QR PAYLOADS OR DIGESTS, DEVICE-INTEGRITY SIGNALS WHERE SUPPORTED, AND REVIEW STATUS.

SOCIAL INFORMATION, INCLUDING FRIEND REQUESTS, BLOCKS, WEEKLY CHALLENGE REQUESTS AND RESULTS, CHALLENGE NAMES, DESCRIPTIONS, SCHEDULES, MEMBERSHIP, CHECK-INS, AND MASKED OR HASHED CONTACT-INVITATION DESTINATIONS.

CREATOR AND PARTNER INFORMATION, INCLUDING PROFILE OR CHANNEL LINKS, HOSTED VIDEO LINKS, WORKOUT DETAILS, RIGHTS ATTESTATIONS, AI OR SPONSOR DISCLOSURES, APPLICATION CONTACT INFORMATION, GYM ADDRESS, AND REVIEW NOTES.

REWARD INFORMATION, INCLUDING ELIGIBILITY, AWARD, CLAIM, AND FULFILLMENT STATUS. AN ASSIGNED COUPON MAY BE DECRYPTED ONLY FOR THE WINNER WHO CLAIMS IT. GOGYMGO DOES NOT COLLECT A SHIPPING ADDRESS IN THE CURRENT VERSION.

TECHNICAL AND SUPPORT INFORMATION NECESSARY TO SECURE AND OPERATE THE SERVICE, INCLUDING REQUEST IDENTIFIERS, IDEMPOTENCY DIGESTS, SECURITY EVENTS, ERROR DETAILS, PUSH-NOTIFICATION TOKENS, MODERATION EVENTS, AND SUPPORT COMMUNICATIONS.

sections.heading: INFORMATION WE DO NOT COLLECT IN THE CURRENT VERSION
bullets: GOGYMGO DOES NOT RECEIVE OR STORE FACE ID, TOUCH ID, FINGERPRINT TEMPLATES, FACEPRINTS, FACE GEOMETRY, DEVICE PASSCODES, RAW CAMERA FRAMES, QR CAMERA VIDEO, VOICE, OR MICROPHONE AUDIO.
DEVICE AUTHENTICATION IS HANDLED BY THE PHONE OPERATING SYSTEM. GOGYMGO RECEIVES ONLY THE RESULT NEEDED FOR THE WORKOUT CHECKPOINT.
GOGYMGO DOES NOT COLLECT PAYMENT-CARD, BANK-ACCOUNT, WALLET, OR TAX-PAYMENT INFORMATION, AND THE CURRENT COMPETITION HAS NO ENTRY FEE.
GOGYMGO DOES NOT USE ADVERTISING IDENTIFIERS OR COLLECT INFORMATION TO TRACK A PERSON ACROSS UNRELATED APPS OR WEBSITES.

sections.heading: WHY WE USE INFORMATION
bullets: CREATE, AUTHENTICATE, SECURE, SUPPORT, AND DELETE ACCOUNTS; PROVIDE PRIVACY EXPORTS; AND REMEMBER USER SETTINGS.
VERIFY THE ELIGIBLE REGION, APPLY LOCAL TIME AND AGE RULES, ENROLL USERS, VERIFY WORKOUTS, CALCULATE PROGRESS AND ENTRIES, PREVENT ABUSE, SETTLE RESULTS, AND AUDIT DISPUTES.
OPERATE FRIENDS, WEEKLY CHALLENGES, SOCIAL CHALLENGES, CREATOR WORKOUT PLANS, MODERATION, REMINDERS, REWARDS, CLAIMS, AND SUPPORT.
REVIEW CREATOR, SPONSOR, AND GYM APPLICATIONS; CONTACT THE APPLICANT ABOUT THE REQUEST; AND ADMINISTER APPROVED PARTNERSHIPS.
COMPLY WITH LAW, ENFORCE TERMS AND CONTEST RULES, PROTECT USERS AND THE SERVICE, INVESTIGATE FRAUD, AND ESTABLISH OR DEFEND LEGAL CLAIMS.

sections.heading: CONSENT AND YOUR CHOICES
sections.body: GOGYMGO REQUESTS INFORMATION FOR IDENTIFIED AND REASONABLE PURPOSES. REQUIRED ACCOUNT, REGION, LEGAL-RECEIPT, AND WORKOUT EVIDENCE IS NEEDED TO PROVIDE THE COMPETITION SERVICE. OPTIONAL ALIAS, AVATAR, CREATOR, SOCIAL, REMINDER, AND PARTNER FEATURES MAY BE DECLINED. OPERATING-SYSTEM PERMISSION IS NOT, BY ITSELF, CONSENT TO AN UNDISCLOSED USE. YOU MAY WITHDRAW CONSENT TO OPTIONAL PROCESSING, SUBJECT TO REASONABLE NOTICE AND LEGAL OR CONTRACTUAL RESTRICTIONS; SOME FEATURES MAY THEN BE UNAVAILABLE.

sections.heading: WHEN INFORMATION IS SHARED
bullets: SERVICE PROVIDERS THAT HOST, AUTHENTICATE, STORE, SECURE, DELIVER NOTIFICATIONS, MODERATE MEDIA, OR SUPPORT THE APP MAY PROCESS ONLY THE INFORMATION NEEDED FOR THEIR SERVICES. CURRENT OR PLANNED PROVIDERS INCLUDE GOOGLE FIREBASE AND GOOGLE CLOUD, APPLE OR GOOGLE SIGN-IN AND DEVICE SERVICES, EXPO NOTIFICATIONS, AND APPROVED HOSTED-VIDEO PROVIDERS. THE FINAL POLICY MUST NAME ALL PRODUCTION PROVIDERS AND LOCATIONS.

APPROVED SPONSORS OR FULFILLMENT PARTNERS MAY RECEIVE THE MINIMUM INFORMATION NEEDED TO VALIDATE OR FULFILL A SPECIFIC REWARD. THEY DO NOT RECEIVE HEART-RATE DATA, BIOMETRIC MATERIAL, EXACT LOCATION EVIDENCE, PRIVATE SOCIAL CONTENT, LEGAL-RECEIPT DETAILS, OR UNRELATED ACCOUNT DATA.

PUBLIC COMPETITION SURFACES MAY DISPLAY THE USER'S PERMITTED ALIAS OR PRIVATE CALLSIGN, APPROVED AVATAR, STREAK BADGES, GOAL GROUP, RANK, VERIFIED PROGRESS, CATEGORY-CHAMPION STATUS, AND REWARD TITLE OR TYPE. EMAIL, EXACT LOCATION, HEART-RATE EVIDENCE, COUPON CODES, AND PRIVATE CLAIM INSTRUCTIONS ARE NOT PUBLIC.

INFORMATION MAY BE DISCLOSED WHEN REQUIRED OR PERMITTED BY LAW, TO PROTECT RIGHTS OR SAFETY, TO INVESTIGATE FRAUD, OR AS PART OF A BUSINESS TRANSACTION SUBJECT TO APPROPRIATE CONFIDENTIALITY AND USE RESTRICTIONS.

sections.heading: INTERNATIONAL PROCESSING
sections.body: SERVICE PROVIDERS MAY PROCESS INFORMATION OUTSIDE BRITISH COLUMBIA OR CANADA, INCLUDING IN THE UNITED STATES, WHERE IT MAY BE SUBJECT TO THE LAWS AND LAWFUL ACCESS AUTHORITIES OF THAT LOCATION. [INSERT FINAL PROVIDER AND PROCESSING-LOCATION LIST]. GOGYMGO REMAINS RESPONSIBLE FOR PERSONAL INFORMATION UNDER ITS CONTROL AND USES CONTRACTUAL, TECHNICAL, AND ORGANIZATIONAL SAFEGUARDS APPROPRIATE TO THE INFORMATION.

sections.heading: RETENTION AND DELETION
sections.body: GOGYMGO RETAINS INFORMATION ONLY AS LONG AS REASONABLY NEEDED FOR THE IDENTIFIED PURPOSE, SECURITY, CONTEST INTEGRITY, REWARD FULFILLMENT, DISPUTES, AND LEGAL REQUIREMENTS. [INSERT COUNSEL-APPROVED RETENTION PERIODS FOR ACCOUNT, LOCATION-DECISION, HEALTH AND WORKOUT EVIDENCE, FRAUD, SOCIAL, MEDIA, APPLICATION, REWARD, NOTIFICATION, LEGAL-RECEIPT, AND AUDIT RECORDS]. AN ACCOUNT-DELETION REQUEST REMOVES OR DE-IDENTIFIES ACTIVE ACCOUNT DATA AFTER APPROVED OPERATIONAL HOLDS. PSEUDONYMOUS LEGAL RECEIPTS, COMPETITION ENROLLMENTS, WORKOUT EVIDENCE, ENTRY LEDGERS, DRAW, REWARD, FRAUD, AND AUDIT RECORDS MAY BE RETAINED WHEN REASONABLY REQUIRED FOR INTEGRITY, DISPUTES, OR LAW. THE FINAL POLICY MUST STATE THE APPROVED PERIODS AND MUST NOT PROMISE DELETION THAT THE SERVICE DOES NOT PERFORM.

sections.heading: SAFEGUARDS AND INCIDENTS
sections.body: GOGYMGO USES ROLE-BASED ACCESS, AUTHENTICATION, ENCRYPTION IN TRANSIT, CONTROLLED PRIVATE STORAGE, APPEND-ONLY EVIDENCE WHERE APPROPRIATE, SECRET MANAGEMENT, AUDIT LOGS, AND DATA-MINIMIZATION CONTROLS. NO SYSTEM IS COMPLETELY SECURE. GOGYMGO WILL INVESTIGATE SUSPECTED PRIVACY OR SECURITY INCIDENTS AND PROVIDE NOTICE WHEN REQUIRED BY APPLICABLE LAW.

sections.heading: ACCESS, CORRECTION, AND COMPLAINTS
sections.body: SUBJECT TO APPLICABLE LAW, YOU MAY REQUEST ACCESS TO PERSONAL INFORMATION UNDER GOGYMGO'S CONTROL, INFORMATION ABOUT ITS USE AND DISCLOSURE, OR CORRECTION OF AN ERROR OR OMISSION. USE ACCOUNT DATA IN THE APP OR CONTACT [INSERT PRIVACY EMAIL]. GOGYMGO MAY NEED TO VERIFY IDENTITY AND MAY WITHHOLD INFORMATION WHERE LAW REQUIRES OR PERMITS. IF A CONCERN IS NOT RESOLVED, BRITISH COLUMBIA USERS MAY CONTACT THE OFFICE OF THE INFORMATION AND PRIVACY COMMISSIONER FOR BRITISH COLUMBIA.

sections.heading: COMMERCIAL MESSAGES
sections.body: SERVICE, SECURITY, COMPETITION, CLAIM, AND ACCOUNT MESSAGES MAY BE SENT AS NEEDED TO PROVIDE THE REQUESTED SERVICE. PROMOTIONAL EMAIL OR TEXT MESSAGES REQUIRE A VALID CONSENT OR OTHER LAWFUL BASIS, IDENTIFY THE SENDER, AND INCLUDE A WORKING UNSUBSCRIBE METHOD. APP REMINDERS MAY BE DISABLED IN SETTINGS AND THROUGH DEVICE PERMISSIONS.

sections.heading: ADULT PILOT
sections.body: THE CURRENT BRITISH COLUMBIA PILOT IS INTENDED ONLY FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE AT LEAST 19 YEARS OLD. GOGYMGO DOES NOT KNOWINGLY OFFER THE PILOT TO MINORS. CONTACT [INSERT PRIVACY EMAIL] IF YOU BELIEVE A MINOR PROVIDED PERSONAL INFORMATION.

sections.heading: CHANGES AND CONTACT
sections.body: MATERIAL CHANGES WILL BE PUBLISHED AS A NEW VERSION AND, WHEN REQUIRED, PRESENTED FOR A NEW ACKNOWLEDGMENT OR AGREEMENT. THIS INTERNAL DRAFT MUST BE REPLACED BEFORE PUBLIC LAUNCH. PRIVACY OFFICER: [INSERT POSITION, LEGAL ENTITY, EMAIL, BUSINESS ADDRESS, AND BUSINESS TELEPHONE].

sections.heading: AGREEMENT AND OPERATOR
sections.body: THE GOGYMGO SERVICE IS OPERATED BY [INSERT LEGAL ENTITY NAME] AT [INSERT BUSINESS ADDRESS]. BY CREATING OR USING AN ACCOUNT AND SELECTING AGREE, YOU ACCEPT THESE TERMS AND THE CURRENT PRIVACY POLICY. IF YOU DO NOT ACCEPT THEM, DO NOT USE THE SERVICE. sections.heading: INTERNAL TESTING ONLY
sections.body: THE CURRENT CONNECTED BUILD, SEPTEMBER 2026 COMPETITION, LEGAL TEXT, REWARDS, PARTNER-GYM FEATURES, AND VERIFICATION INTEGRATIONS ARE TEST CONFIGURATION. NO LIVE PUBLIC CONTEST OR PRIZE OFFER EXISTS UNTIL THE COMPETITION IS PUBLISHED WITH FINAL COUNSEL-APPROVED RULES, A REAL REWARD SCHEDULE, AN IDENTIFIED SPONSOR OR ADMINISTRATOR, AND PERMANENT PRODUCTION INFRASTRUCTURE.

sections.heading: ELIGIBILITY AND ACCOUNT
bullets: YOU MUST BE AT LEAST 19 YEARS OLD, LEGALLY ABLE TO ENTER THESE TERMS, AND PHYSICALLY LOCATED WITHIN THE ACTIVE VANCOUVER ISLAND AND INCLUDED GULF ISLANDS BOUNDARY WHEN REGION VERIFICATION OCCURS.
YOU MUST PROVIDE ACCURATE ACCOUNT, ELIGIBILITY, REGION, WORKOUT, CREATOR, PARTNER, AND REWARD-CLAIM INFORMATION AND KEEP YOUR SIGN-IN CREDENTIALS SECURE.
ONE PERSON MAY USE ONLY THEIR OWN ACCOUNT AND MAY NOT SELL, TRANSFER, SHARE, AUTOMATE, OR CREATE ACCOUNTS TO MANIPULATE ELIGIBILITY, RANK, ENTRIES, REWARDS, OR SOCIAL FEATURES.
EMAIL VERIFICATION, CURRENT LEGAL RECEIPTS, REGION VERIFICATION, AGE ATTESTATION, COMPETITION-RULE ACCEPTANCE, AND A VALID WEEKLY GOAL MAY BE REQUIRED BEFORE COMPETITION FEATURES ARE AVAILABLE.

sections.heading: FREE SERVICE AND NO PURCHASE
sections.body: THE CURRENT VERSION HAS NO USER PURCHASE, SUBSCRIPTION, ENTRY FEE, BANK, WALLET, CASH, OR STORED-VALUE FEATURE. NO PURCHASE IS NECESSARY TO JOIN AN ELIGIBLE COMPETITION OR OBTAIN THE FREE ENTRY DESCRIBED IN ITS FINAL OFFICIAL RULES. A PURCHASE OR COMMERCIAL INTERACTION MUST NOT IMPROVE A USER'S CHANCES OF WINNING.

sections.heading: FITNESS SAFETY AND NO MEDICAL ADVICE
bullets: GOGYMGO PROVIDES FITNESS TRACKING, WORKOUT GUIDANCE, AND COMPETITION FEATURES FOR GENERAL INFORMATION AND RECREATIONAL USE. IT DOES NOT PROVIDE MEDICAL ADVICE, DIAGNOSIS, TREATMENT, EMERGENCY MONITORING, OR A SUBSTITUTE FOR A QUALIFIED HEALTH PROFESSIONAL.

PHYSICAL ACTIVITY INVOLVES RISKS INCLUDING STRAIN, FALLS, COLLISION, ILLNESS, SERIOUS INJURY, OR DEATH. CONSIDER YOUR HEALTH, EXPERIENCE, ENVIRONMENT, EQUIPMENT, AND INSTRUCTIONS; USE APPROPRIATE MODIFICATIONS; STOP IF YOU FEEL PAIN, DIZZINESS, FAINTNESS, CHEST DISCOMFORT, OR OTHER CONCERNING SYMPTOMS; AND SEEK APPROPRIATE MEDICAL OR EMERGENCY HELP.
HEART-RATE, TIMER, DEVICE, QR, STREAK, SCORE, AND ENTRY INFORMATION MAY BE DELAYED, INCOMPLETE, OR INACCURATE AND MUST NOT BE USED FOR MEDICAL OR SAFETY-CRITICAL DECISIONS.
YOU CHOOSE WHETHER AND HOW TO PARTICIPATE. NOTHING IN THESE TERMS EXCLUDES A RIGHT OR RESPONSIBILITY THAT CANNOT LAWFULLY BE EXCLUDED.

sections.heading: WORKOUT AND REGION VERIFICATION
bullets: A VERIFIED WORKOUT MAY REQUIRE THE PUBLISHED MINIMUM DURATION, HEART-RATE EVIDENCE, LOCAL DEVICE-PRESENCE CHECKS, OR PARTNER-GYM ENTRY AND EXIT QR CHECKPOINTS.

THE PHONE OPERATING SYSTEM HANDLES FACE ID, TOUCH ID, FINGERPRINT, OR PASSCODE AUTHENTICATION. GOGYMGO RECEIVES THE RESULT, NOT THE BIOMETRIC TEMPLATE OR PASSCODE. QR CAMERA FRAMES ARE PROCESSED LOCALLY AND ARE NOT STORED; A VALIDATED QR RESULT MAY BE SUBMITTED.

YOU MUST NOT SPOOF LOCATION, HEART RATE, TIME, DEVICE OR ATTESTATION SIGNALS; SHARE QR CODES; RECORD OR DISTRIBUTE ACCESS CODES; USE ANOTHER PERSON OR DEVICE TO COMPLETE A CHECK; TAMPER WITH EVIDENCE; OR INTERFERE WITH REVIEW.
GOGYMGO MAY REJECT OR REVIEW A SESSION, SCORE, ENTRY, ENROLLMENT, OR CLAIM WHEN EVIDENCE IS MISSING, INCONSISTENT, LATE, DUPLICATED, UNSUPPORTED, OR REASONABLY SUSPECTED OF ABUSE.

sections.heading: COMPETITIONS, ENTRIES, AND REWARDS
bullets: PRIZE-DRAW ENTRIES AFFECT RELATIVE CHANCES BUT NEVER GUARANTEE A REWARD. ODDS DEPEND ON THE NUMBER OF ELIGIBLE ENTRIES RECEIVED AND THE FINAL PRIZE ALLOCATION.

THE OFFICIAL RULES MUST DISCLOSE THE OPENING AND CLOSING DATES, ELIGIBLE AREA, NUMBER AND APPROXIMATE VALUE OF PRIZES, REGIONAL ALLOCATION, MATERIAL FACTS AFFECTING CHANCES, DRAW METHOD, CLAIM DEADLINE, SKILL-TESTING REQUIREMENT, AND OTHER CONDITIONS BEFORE A PUBLIC CONTEST OPENS.

A POTENTIAL WINNER IS NOT CONFIRMED UNTIL ELIGIBILITY, EVIDENCE, RULE COMPLIANCE, AND ANY REQUIRED MATHEMATICAL SKILL-TESTING QUESTION ARE COMPLETED. A DISPLAYED RANK, MESSAGE, OR AWARD-PENDING STATE IS NOT FINAL CONFIRMATION.

SPONSOR TERMS, INVENTORY, EXPIRY, SUBSTITUTION, DELIVERY AREA, AND CLAIM INSTRUCTIONS MAY APPLY. GOGYMGO DOES NOT GUARANTEE A THIRD-PARTY PRODUCT OR SERVICE AND DOES NOT COLLECT SHIPPING ADDRESSES IN THE CURRENT VERSION.
THE COMPETITION MAY BE CANCELLED OR NOT LAUNCHED IF ITS PUBLISHED MINIMUM ELIGIBLE ENTRANT COUNT IS NOT MET, OR AS OTHERWISE PERMITTED BY THE FINAL OFFICIAL RULES AND APPLICABLE LAW.

sections.heading: SOCIAL FEATURES AND PUBLIC RESULTS
sections.body: FRIEND REQUESTS, WEEKLY CHALLENGES, AND SOCIAL CHALLENGES REQUIRE THE APPLICABLE INVITATION OR ACCEPTANCE. DO NOT HARASS, THREATEN, IMPERSONATE, DOX, DISCRIMINATE, SPAM, OR SHARE ANOTHER PERSON'S PRIVATE INFORMATION. PERMITTED PUBLIC RESULTS MAY DISPLAY YOUR ALIAS OR PRIVATE CALLSIGN, APPROVED AVATAR, STREAK BADGES, GOAL GROUP, RANK, VERIFIED PROGRESS, CATEGORY-CHAMPION STATUS, AND REWARD TITLE OR TYPE.

sections.heading: CREATOR AND USER CONTENT
sections.body: YOU RETAIN OWNERSHIP OF CONTENT YOU OWN. A CREATOR SUBMISSION IS SUBJECT TO THE SEPARATE RIGHTS ATTESTATION PRESENTED AT SUBMISSION, INCLUDING THE STATED LICENSE FOR HOSTING, REPRODUCTION, EDITING, FORMATTING, CAPTIONING, TRANSLATION, APPROVED BRAND PLACEMENT, AND DISCLOSED AI-ASSISTED ADAPTATION. YOU MUST HAVE ALL NECESSARY VIDEO, MUSIC, LIKENESS, LOCATION, TRADEMARK, AND OTHER RIGHTS. GOGYMGO MAY REVIEW, DECLINE, PAUSE, REMOVE, OR REPORT CONTENT FOR SAFETY, RIGHTS, DISCLOSURE, LEGAL, OR BRAND-FIT REASONS.

sections.heading: PARTNERS AND THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
sections.body: FIREBASE, APPLE, GOOGLE, EXPO, HOSTED-VIDEO PROVIDERS, WEARABLE OR HEALTH PLATFORMS, GYMS, CREATORS, SPONSORS, AND REWARD-FULFILLMENT PROVIDERS MAY HAVE THEIR OWN TERMS AND PRIVACY PRACTICES. GOGYMGO IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR A THIRD PARTY'S INDEPENDENT SERVICE, CONTENT, AVAILABILITY, OR CONDUCT, SUBJECT TO RIGHTS THAT CANNOT LAWFULLY BE LIMITED.

sections.heading: ACCEPTABLE USE
sections.body: DO NOT BREAK LAW; INFRINGE RIGHTS; INTRODUCE MALWARE; SCRAPE, REVERSE ENGINEER, OVERLOAD, OR BYPASS SECURITY EXCEPT WHERE LAW EXPRESSLY PERMITS; MISUSE SPONSOR OR GYM MARKS; ACCESS ANOTHER ACCOUNT; MANIPULATE ENTRIES OR RESULTS; MAKE UNSAFE OR DECEPTIVE FITNESS CLAIMS; OR USE GOGYMGO TO SEND UNLAWFUL COMMERCIAL MESSAGES.

sections.heading: SUSPENSION AND TERMINATION
sections.body: YOU MAY STOP USING THE SERVICE AND REQUEST ACCOUNT DELETION THROUGH ACCOUNT DATA. GOGYMGO MAY RESTRICT, SUSPEND, OR TERMINATE ACCESS, INVALIDATE AFFECTED EVIDENCE OR ENTRIES, OR REFER A MATTER FOR REVIEW WHEN REASONABLY NECESSARY FOR SAFETY, SECURITY, FRAUD, LEGAL COMPLIANCE, OR MATERIAL BREACH. WHERE APPROPRIATE, GOGYMGO WILL PROVIDE NOTICE AND A REASONABLE REVIEW OR SUPPORT CHANNEL. APPROVED RECORDS MAY BE RETAINED AS DESCRIBED IN THE PRIVACY POLICY.

sections.heading: SERVICE AVAILABILITY AND DISCLAIMERS
sections.body: THE INTERNAL TEST SERVICE IS PROVIDED AS AVAILABLE AND MAY BE CHANGED, PAUSED, OR DISCONTINUED. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, GOGYMGO DOES NOT PROMISE UNINTERRUPTED OR ERROR-FREE OPERATION, COMPATIBILITY WITH EVERY DEVICE OR PROVIDER, CONTINUOUS PARTNER OR REWARD AVAILABILITY, OR THAT FITNESS CONTENT WILL BE SUITABLE FOR EVERY PERSON. STATUTORY, CONSUMER, PRIVACY, AND OTHER RIGHTS THAT CANNOT LAWFULLY BE WAIVED REMAIN UNAFFECTED.
